quote: Using "namespace" as a class constant name is deprecated.
reason: A class, interface or trait constant named namespace is visible in the declaration; it is reported in any case (const NAMESPACE too, as the php-8.6.0RC7 source compares without case), and the fixtures show PHP 7.4-8.5 accept it silently, so the 8.6 claim is documented only. An enum case named namespace is a class constant too (php-8.6.0RC7 Zend/tests/deprecate_namespace_class_constant.phpt) and is reported; its fixture is runtime.* because enums go through eval() to run on 7.4 and 8.0.

quote: Using the return statement in a finally block is now deprecated.
reason: Any return statement inside a finally block of the same function is visible in the syntax tree; the fixtures show 7.4-8.5 run it silently (the finally value wins), 8.6 is documented only.

quote: Specifying a return type of array|null / ?array for __debugInfo() is now deprecated.
reason: The return type ?array / array|null / null|array of __debugInfo() is in the declaration; ?array has a rule fixture, array|null only parses from 8.0 so it is shown through eval() in a runtime fixture, and both run silently on 7.4-8.5.

quote: Returning values from __construct() and __destruct() is now deprecated.
reason: A return with a value (null included) written directly in __construct() or __destruct() is visible; a bare return; and returns of nested closures are not reported. True positives seen in the WordPress 4.0 corpus.

quote: Making __construct() and __destruct() a Generator is now deprecated.
reason: A yield or yield from written directly in __construct() or __destruct() makes it a generator and is visible in the syntax tree; 7.4-8.5 run it silently.

quote: Naming a function readonly is now deprecated.
reason: A function declaration named readonly is visible; the fixture shows it compiles and runs silently on 7.4-8.5. WordPress 7.1.4 has one, wp-includes/php-compat/readonly.php, which it only includes on PHP < 8.1.

quote: Using "let" or "is" as the name of a class, interface, trait, enum, function, or constant (including via define()), as the alias passed to class_alias(), or as the alias name in a use, use function, or use const declaration is now deprecated.
reason: Declarations of classes, interfaces, traits, enums, functions and constants, define() and class_alias() with a literal name, and use aliases are visible; an enum only parses from 8.1, so it is shown through eval() in a runtime fixture. A name from a variable is not reported.

quote: Using "_" as a constant name (via const or define()), or as the alias name for a class or constant in a use declaration, is now deprecated.
reason: const _, define( '_' ) with a literal name and use ... as _ for a class or constant are visible; the fixtures show 8.4 and 8.5 do not yet deprecate the use alias (only the 8.4 class-name case), as the notes say. A function alias "_" is not in the notes and is not reported.

quote: Passing a 3rd argument to define() is now deprecated.
reason: Any third argument to define() is visible in the call; a literal true is left out because 7.3 already deprecated it and 8.0 made it a warning (call.define_case_insensitive covers where that changes behaviour), so one claim cannot describe it.

quote: Calling is_a() or is_subclass_of() with a string as the first argument when $allow_string is false is now deprecated.
reason: Reported when the first argument is written as a string (literal, interpolated, Foo::class, get_class( $x )) and $allow_string is false (omitted for is_a(), literal false for both); a string from a variable is run-time only and has a runtime fixture. 7.4-8.5 silently return false.

quote: Passing an object for the Bzip2 {de}compression stream filter is now deprecated.
reason: None of the runtimes has the bz2 extension (stream_filter_append() cannot locate "bzip2.compress" on 7.4-8.5), so nothing can be shown; the filter parameters are also a run-time value.

quote: The shift (<<, >>) and exponentiation (**) operators on GMP objects now emit a deprecation warning when converting a float right operand to int loses precision.
reason: None of the runtimes has the gmp extension (extension_loaded( 'gmp' ) is false), and the loss of precision depends on run-time float values.

quote: Mbregex has been deprecated, because the underlying Oniguruma library is no longer maintained.
reason: The 16 mb_ereg*() / mb_regex_*() / mb_split() functions are in data/catalog/functions.php as deprecated in 8.6 (documented) and are reported by InternalFunctions.

quote: Passing objects to mb_convert_variables() is now deprecated.
reason: The variables are passed by reference, so the object always comes from a variable whose type is known at run time only; the fixture shows 7.4-8.5 accept an object silently.

quote: The mysqli_get_charset() function and mysqli::get_charset() method are now deprecated.
reason: mysqli_get_charset() is in the catalog (function.deprecated); ->get_charset() is reported only where the receiver is certainly a mysqli object (new mysqli or a mysqli parameter); the fixture only compiles the call, as there is no database server.

quote: The mysqli_stmt_init() function, mysqli::stmt_init() method, and calling the mysqli_stmt constructor without providing the $query parameter are now deprecated.
reason: mysqli_stmt_init() is in the catalog; ->stmt_init() on a known mysqli object is call.mysqli_deprecated_method and new mysqli_stmt( $link ) without a query (or with a literal null) is call.mysqli_stmt_without_query; the fixtures only compile the code, as there is no database server.

quote: Calling ReflectionProperty::setValue() with an object that is not an instance of the class on which the property was declared is now deprecated.
reason: Which object reaches setValue() and which class declared the property are run-time values; the fixture shows 7.4-8.5 silently write the property of the foreign object.

quote: Calling ReflectionProperty::setRawValue() with an object that is not an instance of the class on which the property was declared is now deprecated.
reason: Same as setValue(), for setRawValue(), which exists from 8.4; the fixture calls it where it exists and shows 8.4-8.5 accept a foreign object silently.

quote: Calling ReflectionMethod::invoke() or ReflectionMethod::invokeArgs() with an object and a static method is now deprecated.
reason: Whether the reflected method is static is not visible at the call of invoke() / invokeArgs(); the fixtures show 7.4-8.5 ignore the object silently.

quote: It is now deprecated to pass an object that does not implement the create_sid() and validateId() methods.
reason: Only an object implementing SessionHandlerInterface can be passed, so the missing methods are reported at its class declaration (no extends, no traits); the fixture passes such an object to session_set_save_handler() and 7.4-8.5 accept it silently.

quote: A deprecation is now emitted when implementing SessionHandlerInterface on a class which doesn't define the create_sid() or validateId() methods, as those will be moved from SessionUpdateTimestampHandlerInterface and SessionIdInterface to SessionHandlerInterface.
reason: A class that implements SessionHandlerInterface and declares no create_sid() or validateId() is visible; note that the php-8.6.0RC7 source raises E_WARNING, not E_DEPRECATED, at the declaration, while the notes say deprecation, so the finding follows the notes and is documented only.

quote: The spl_classes() function is now deprecated.
reason: spl_classes() is in data/catalog/functions.php as deprecated in 8.6 (documented).

quote: The spl_object_hash() function is now deprecated.
reason: spl_object_hash() is in data/catalog/functions.php as deprecated in 8.6 (documented, instead spl_object_id()).

quote: The following ArrayIterator methods are now deprecated:
reason: The ten methods are reported where the receiver is certainly an ArrayIterator or RecursiveArrayIterator (Php85DepMethods::known_class()); ArrayObject keeps its methods. One fixture per method, all silent on 7.4-8.5.

quote: The following SplFileObject methods are now deprecated:
reason: The four methods are reported where the receiver is certainly an SplFileObject or SplTempFileObject; the fixtures pass $escape explicitly so that the 8.4 deprecation of its default does not show up, and are silent on 7.4-8.5.

quote: metaphone() is deprecated.
reason: metaphone() is in data/catalog/functions.php as deprecated in 8.6 (documented).

quote: Using more than 16 filters in a php://filter URL without configuring the "filter.max_filter_count" stream context option now emits an E_DEPRECATED warning.
reason: The filter chain is a run-time string, almost always built from values, and plugin code has no reason to write one out; the fixture shows 17 filters run silently on 7.4-8.5.

quote: Passing an object to array_walk{_recursive} is now deprecated.
reason: The array is passed by reference, so an object always comes from a variable whose type is known at run time only; the fixtures show 7.4-8.5 walk the object properties silently.

quote: Passing an object as the $data argument to http_build_query() is now deprecated.
reason: Only an object written in the call (new, (object), $this) is reported; an object in a variable and an object nested in the array (the second sentence of the bullet) are run-time values with runtime fixtures, all silent on 7.4-8.5.

quote: The is_double() function is now deprecated.
reason: is_double() is in data/catalog/functions.php as deprecated in 8.6 (documented, instead is_float()).

quote: The is_long() and is_integer() functions are now deprecated.
reason: is_long() and is_integer() are in data/catalog/functions.php as deprecated in 8.6 (documented, instead is_int()).

quote: The doubleval() function is now deprecated.
reason: doubleval() is in data/catalog/functions.php as deprecated in 8.6 (documented, instead floatval()).

quote: The strcoll() function is now deprecated.
reason: strcoll() is in data/catalog/functions.php as deprecated in 8.6 (documented).

quote: The SORT_LOCALE_STRING constant for the family of sort functions is now deprecated.
reason: SORT_LOCALE_STRING is in data/catalog/constants.php as deprecated in 8.6 (documented) and is reported by InternalConstants.

quote: Passing an object for the zlib deflate and inflate stream filter is now deprecated.
reason: The filter name and parameters of stream_filter_append() / stream_filter_prepend() are run-time values; the fixture shows 7.4-8.5 accept an object for zlib.deflate silently.

quote: Passing an object as the $option argument to deflate_init and inflate_init is now deprecated.
reason: An object written as the $options argument (new, (object), $this) is reported; an object in a variable is a run-time value with a runtime fixture; 7.4-8.5 accept both silently.
